plan.title: 2x2 genotype x treatment interaction DE + pathway analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the drug act differently in KO than in WT brain tissue — is by definition a genotype-by-treatment interaction question in a 2x2 factorial design (WT/KO x vehicle/drug, n=4/cell, 16 samples, 12000 genes, raw salmon counts). The plan follows the DESeq2 interaction-design workflow returned by the knowledge service: (1) QC on variance-stabilized counts to confirm the four groups separate as expected and no sample is an outlier before any test runs; (2) fit DESeq2 with design ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment, with explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle), and extract three results tables per gene — the drug effect in WT (reference), the drug effect in KO, and the interaction contrast (genotype:treatment) that is the actual test of 'does the drug act differently in KO vs WT'; effects are shrunk with ashr because these are contrasts, not single coefficients; (3) run fgsea preranked GSEA (rank metric = Wald statistic) separately for each of the three results tables against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary, filtered to Homo sapiens) since both are staged for human; (4) produce a report that lays out all three tables side by side with the named reference levels, flags the known low power of the interaction term at n=4/cell, reports diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histograms) and the reproducibility record. No translational/safety/PK steps are added since the question is a mechanistic genotype x drug interaction, not a clinical or drug-safety question.
